title: Preanalytic influences in laboratory diagnostics at the University Hospital Bonn
summary: The laboratory samples sent to the Central Laboratory of the University Hospital Bonn between 09/2017 and 01/2025 are examined in a look-back study to find discolouring of blood plasma, which can influence laboratory testing. Discolouring has already been monitored during the sample analysis. Barcodes and case numbers are used to match each sample to its place of origin (outpatient department, regular wards, intensive care units and the medical speciality). Aim is to find out whether sepecific areas in the clinic send in significantly higher numbers of discoloured samples than others.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of all blood samples sent to the Cental Laboratory between 09/2017 and 01/2025 with special focus on the samples flagged as haemolytic, icteric or lipemic by the laboratory automatisation.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Data analysis of blood samples sent to the Central Laboratory of the University Hospital Bonn between 09/2017 and 01/2025 from patient care.
Exclusion criteria:
Blood samples sent during the aforementioned time-frame if they were sent by external clinics (e.g. emergency testing) or sent by research departments.
